summary: Gabbro's Island is a floating island on Giant's Deep where Gabbro has set up their camp. It is recognizable by the trail of campfire smoke rising from above the island.

biology: Gabbro's Island has a gravity of approximately 2 g.
Gabbro's Island floats on Giant's Deep's ocean.
behavior: Gabbro's Island can be thrown into the atmosphere when a cyclone passes overhead, just like the other islands on Giant's Deep.
location: Gabbro's Island is one of the islands on Giant's Deep.
Gabbro's Island is recognizable by the campfire smoke trailing above it.
Gabbro's Island has a small mountain on it.
A nearby cave on Gabbro's Island contains a small amount of Ghost Matter.
Gabbro lounges in a hammock under the small island mountain near the island's shore.
Gabbro's camp is located slightly higher on the island than the hammock, around the back side of the mountain from the shore.
Gabbro's camp has oxygen refill, fuel refill, and a campfire.
lore: Gabbro is the inhabitant of Gabbro's Island.
Gabbro is not concerned when their island is thrown into the atmosphere by a cyclone.
